title: Chapter 719
paragraphs: Chapter 719
Episode 180. Each One's Fight(9)
Diphus's body was shimmering in the afterimage left by the strike. Blood-like aura spurted from his torn left arm and wing.
What both of them entwined in now can't be called a fight.
Cornered, Diphus barely swung his sword, Volgar, and Jin incessantly thrust his blade into Diphus's openings.
Every time he did, a large hole appeared in Diphus's flesh. If Diphus was human, he would have died over ten times by now.
Jin wielded his ruthless sword. As if he was going to erase every particle of Diphus's flesh.
"Guh, Diphus's memory! Are you really recognizing me as a different being?"
Kwaang! The great sword Volgar, blocking Jin's short sword, was thrust into the ground.

"You talk weirdly since a while ago, saying that you swallowed my brother or something. I understand that you're thrilled about having the upper hand, but look closely. I'm Diphus Runecandle, your brother."
"There is no one who can use the name Runecandle in the Garden of Swords now."

"Heh heh, it might be so from your point of view. But it's not convenient to keep treating me like someone else. Not only is it not true, it's not respectful towards an opponent who doesn't become cowardly even when cornered, little brother."
Suddenly, Diphus's mood changed.
His swordsmanship, which lost its center due to being on the defensive, quickly regained stability, and Volgar held destructive power as it did in the beginning.
'Is this the last resistance?'
Jin had always kept in mind that Diphus might have saved some power.
'It's not self-destruction but enhancement.'
Whatever it was, it didn't matter. Even if it was a self-destruction of the decisive machine volcano level, he could stop it, and even if Diphus got stronger, it was the same.
However, Jin soon found out that Diphus's change was not just that.
The great sword Volgar began to hold a bright white radiance instead of the aura.
The unique fierce energy of the Runecandle was making Volgar shine.
Jin momentarily widened the distance and locked eyes with Diphus. He was breaking the horn on his forehead with a mad laugh.
"Do I still seem like another being, not your brother?"
The deep voice that had been amplified also returned to Diphus's original tone, and the wings that grew on his back fell to the ground like withered flowers.
From the wounds all over his body, hot, red blood flowed instead of the aura.
'He reverted... the body transformation?'
Diphus, who stood in front of Jin again, was unmistakably the same as before.
Of course, this was not something included in Jin's expectations.
"Answer me, little brother."
"What on earth..."
"It's inevitable that you and I have become enemies and are fighting. But at least, you shouldn't try to alleviate your guilt by recognizing me as a different being."
If Diphus had begged for his life in his old form, Jin would have thought it was a ploy to survive.
However, the look in Diphus's eyes, now that he had returned to his old form, was still filled with the will of someone prepared to die.
On the other hand, Jin's heart couldn't help but waver for a moment.
"While you were away for solitary training... I had to fight a pretty tough battle as the fourth generation of our clan, along with that girl, Meri."
Diphus said that and struck Volgar at Jin.
Jin parried the sword and never took his eyes off Diphus.
No matter how many times he looked, it was Diphus.
"When our mother accepted Chaos, the clan changed in an instant. Many, including me, tried to resist it, but it was no use. Those who resisted our mother were simply chased and died day by day."
Do you think I would have resented you then?
Jin couldn't answer the following remark.

"I didn't resent anyone. Even though the clan was inevitably changing, our father who showed no signs of coming back, Sister Luna, you who left alone, even our mother who was oppressing us at the time. Why? Because I thought all this happened because of my weakness."
"So what do you want to say."

"But throughout the fight, you resented and hated me. Recognizing me not as Diphus Runecandle but as a monster of chaos. Am I not myself to you because I accepted Chaos? Is that really a question you can decide? Joshua is still Joshua even though he's tainted with chaos, am I not Diphus now?"
"Don't you dare compare that bastard with Brother Diphus."

"You're still in denial. Jin, little brother. Let me tell you one fact. Receiving a share of our mother's authority is impossible without one's own will. Even if our mother tries to bestow it forcibly, it can't be received. It means I became a fragment of the abomination by my own will!"
Jin's eyes widened and also trembled.
But a few seconds later, Jin soon regained his composure.
Even if everything Diphus spat out was true, nothing would change.
"...I understand what you're saying. No matter what the reason for choosing Chaos was, it's a shame it turned out this way. I will also try not to resent you."
"Good, you should."
The brothers' swords were entangled again.
As soon as the offense and defense began, more afterimages were added to Diphus's body.
The wounds no longer healed. Unlike before, Diphus would be done for if he received a fatal wound now.
Jin's sword still bore no mercy.
'Is this the area Brother reached before he was tainted by Chaos...'
So powerful.
Even someone as powerful as this could not resist Chaos in the end.
That thought occurred to him.
However, being powerful is only an objective criterion.
To Jin, who practically reached the top, Diphus's sword could not be a threat.
"Argh!"
Bradamante sliced Diphus's waist. Blood gushed from the opened wound.
From that moment on, Diphus's movements noticeably slowed down.
While the monsters tainted by Chaos didn't care about such wounds, humans tend to slow down when hurt.
This sight tore Jin's heart painfully.

Jin swung his sword silently. Every time he sliced, tore, and pierced Diphus's body with his blade, a vivid sensation, enough to send chills down his hand, was conveyed. The sensation that he was killing a person, a brother.
"Our mother is incomparable to me. Do you really think you can succeed in the rebellion...!"
Ahh!
A red lump fell from Diphus's abdomen. Holding it with one hand, he swung Volgar like a ghost.

"Failed to save our clan, and you're trying to save the world? Did you come to find Licalten in order to save people? Stop this nonsense, you're a hypocrite and a traitor. Although our mother accepted Chaos, she didn't join hands with her sworn enemy!"
Crack!
Cracks formed in the blade of Volgar. The life of the sword was ending while enduring Jin's relentless attacks.
Once, twice, three times.
With every strike of Bradamante, sharp fragments sprang from Volgar.
Some of them grazed Jin's face. Blood dripped from Jin's cheek.
Eventually, when the seventh attack was launched, Volgar shattered into pieces.
Even though his sword and body were completely wrecked, Diphus was still full of vitality.
His eyes, seemingly unbreakable, were fierce.
Jin paused and looked at Diphus.
"Come. Are you hesitating? Haha, did you stop your sword because you're afraid to kill me?"
A streak of sword energy shot from the shattered Volgar.
Jin didn't dodge it. Due to its faint aura, the sword energy was swept away by his energy before it could even touch him.

Nevertheless, Diphus fired the sword energy several times. With each attempt to attack, the sword energy became fainter, Volgar shook off the remaining fragments, and blood spurted all over Diphus's body.
This was his determination to leave at least a bruise on Jin's body even if he had to die this way. It was his fighting spirit to appear in a dream as a vengeful spirit if that too was impossible.
"Or do you, cough, want to mock me?"
That wasn't the case.
Jin stopped because he couldn't understand.
How could such a powerful person, a person who never yields to death and pain, a person who can struggle so fiercely... accept the power of the monstrosity.
Surrender to Chaos.
He couldn't accept it at all.
"Why... Why did you do that? What made you like this, Brother?"

"What made me like this is solely me. Don't look for that reason elsewhere. After all, as you say, nothing changes. Why, do you still need something to resent? You're wrong. If you also don't like this situation, resent yourself."
The moment Diphus finished speaking,
Suddenly, spirit energy started to surge around him.
Jin tried to cut the spirit energy wrapping around Diphus in haste, but at the same time, a white dimensional gate was opening in front of him.
[Boing!]
"Jin!"
Mot, Cyrus, and Valeria were reaching out to Jin from the white dimensional gate.
Valeria had been analyzing the record of the battlefield all this time and just now figured out the last move of the prophet.
"Stop, you can't kill the fourth knight now! We have to get rid of the prophet first...!"
"Valeria, what's that about."
"The prophet cast a magic on the fourth knight. It's a cursed spell that's set to return the power Diphus received to the monstrosity the moment he dies."
From the beginning, Diphus's purpose was to recover the monstrosity through his death.
That's why he has been taking Jin out separately so far, giving the prophet time to complete the curse.
If Jin had attacked Licalten Castle with his allies from the start, the war would have ended before the prophet could curse Diphus.
If Jin had killed Diphus without doubting him now, Rosa would have regained her power just as she was, and awakened.
Behind the white dimensional gate, Diphus, who was engulfed by spirit energy, disappeared without a trace.

"We can only prevent the curse from being triggered by getting rid of the wizard first. Hurry, the fourth knight has been summoned to Licalten Castle now. Go back right away, kill the prophet, and destroy the power of the monstrosity the fourth knight has!"
